records.rule: Admit only public state plus the acting party's own private field into a live prompt; observer narration and other-party private state are fail-closed before provider invocation.
records.audit: persist counts and digest identity, not prompt text

records.rule: Where effect must stay interpretable, constrain to a frozen classified catalog and reject unknown tokens rather than guessing.
records.note: the classifier, not the model, is authoritative for phrase/class/pressure deltas

records.rule: An observer never mutates what it observes; mutation-shaped operations over an observation channel fail closed.
records.sensitive: passwords remain non-display evidence with no raw value in snapshot/history

records.rule: A helper never invents an operational fact, entitlement or capability; an unresolved outcome gate becomes REVIEW_REQUIRED, not a guess.
records.credentials: absent/rejected credential fails closed; no silent substitute model without an explicitly published policy

records.rule: Reproducibility is behavioural, not a timing fact; prove the observer did not change the result by replay, keep audit as identity not payload copies.
A bounded response trigger is consumed at most once; releasing capabilities repeats no more than permitted.
records.note: e.g. each incoming utterance can trigger at most one retaliation
